messages.content: Write realistic SMS conversation #93: rural North Dakota patient (pt-1006, hypertension), routine weekly check-in with Northline Care agent. 4–8 texts, natural tone variation, agent clearly states what it cannot do.

**Northline Care Weekly Check-In — Conversation #93**

Mon, 2:14 PM

Northline Care: Hey pt-1006, weekly check-in! Got a reading for me?

Patient: Yep, BP was 138/86 this morning

Northline Care: Thanks for logging that. U staying on ur meds?

Patient: Every morning, no problem. Also quick Q—should I cut back on salt?

Northline Care: Ill log that reading and meds. On the salt question, I can't give diet advice—that's for ur doctor. But great work staying consistent!

Patient: Ok got it

Northline Care: Next check Friday. Keep going 👍

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
